@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-name: Publish docs
+name: docs
 
 # Publishes the Fern docs site with `fern generate --docs`.
 #
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@ env:
   STAGING_INSTANCE: nvidia-cudnn-staging.docs.buildwithfern.com/cudnn
 
 jobs:
-  publish:
+  fern-publish:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-name: Docs check
+name: docs
 
 # Validates the Fern docs project under docs/fern: the navigation in
 # versions/latest.yml must stay in sync with the MDX/Markdown under docs/,

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-name: PR merge requirements
+name: analysis
 
 # Blocks merging until the PR has a Milestone. Runs as `pull_request_target`
 # so that PRs from forks get the repo secrets; this is safe because the job
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@ permissions:
   pull-requests: read
 
 jobs:
-  merge-requirements:
+  pr-merge-requirements:
     # Draft PRs are skipped; marking one ready for review runs the check.
     if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-name: Style check
+name: analysis
 
 # Enforces the formatting contract in CONTRIBUTING.md: clang-format for
 # C++/CUDA and black (line length 160) for Python/notebooks, exactly as

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-name: Security scan
+name: analysis
 
 on:
   pull_request:
@@ -19,8 +19,7 @@ permissions:
   contents: read
 
 jobs:
-  codeql-cpp:
-    name: CodeQL C/C++
+  codeql-c-cpp:
     if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     permissions:
@@ -44,7 +43,6 @@ jobs:
         uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@6f2ac81f5cd81fe351a197ba0b00d91d03cd2aee # v4
 
   codeql-python:
-    name: CodeQL Python
     if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft == false
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     permissions:
@@ -67,7 +65,6 @@ jobs:
         uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@6f2ac81f5cd81fe351a197ba0b00d91d03cd2aee # v4
 
   dependency-review:
-    name: Dependency review
     if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     permissions:

@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
